title: Entitlement experiment: telemetry tiers + compliance & premium SLA gating
creator: Nina Patel
description: Run a three-arm pricing & entitlement experiment combining telemetry/observability retention tiers, a compliance add-on, and a premium SLA product. Goal is to validate willingness-to-pay and contract gating controls for enterprise customers while ensuring we cover legal and security questionnaire items required for sales. Deliverables: experiment cohort definitions, entitlement gating implementation plan, pricing sensitivity matrix, sales playbook steps, legal questionnaire answers and checklist.
background: Enterprise prospects repeatedly ask for longer observability retention, audit-grade logs, and guaranteed response SLAs. We currently offer a single observability retention setting with limited retention and no bundled compliance pack. Sales and Solutions Engineering report that being able to present priced add-ons would accelerate renewals/expansion. Legal requires a security questionnaire update to map add-on capabilities to SOC2 / encryption controls before we show pricing in contracts.
proposal: Create three paid entitlements: 1) Telemetry-Lite: +7 day retention (default free tier remains 3 days), low cost per GB; 2) Telemetry-Pro + Compliance Pack: 90 day retention, audit logs export, basic attestations (data processing addendum, encryption at rest/transport options); 3) Premium SLA: 99.95% uptime with faster support SLAs and runbook-backed incident escalation. Implement experimental pricing for each entitlement and surface them as optional add-ons in the quote/console. Gate availability via entitlements flags so we can measure uptake by cohort and disable if necessary.
experiment_design: Randomized account-level cohorting across inbound trial signups and sales demos for 8 weeks. Cohorts: Control (no add-ons shown), PriceVisible (add-ons shown with prices), SalesOffer (sales rep offers 1-month trial of Telemetry-Pro + Compliance Pack during demo). Sample target: 300 accounts per cohort with minimum $10k ARR signal. Track conversion to paid add-on, average incremental ARR, trial-to-paid time. Use feature flags to toggle entitlement UI and billing hooks. Run legal questionnaire for SalesOffer customers before trial activation.
success_metrics: Primary: add-on conversion rate >= 6% within 30 days (PriceVisible cohort). Secondary: incremental ARR per converted account >= $1,800/year; reduction in sales cycle length for accounts that accept SalesOffer; number of security questionnaires completed without open legal issues. Operational: no more than 2 incidents tied to new data export features during experiment.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (2 weeks): Legal & Security questionnaire mapping, billing backend spike, simple console UX mockups. Phase 1 (4 weeks): Implement gating flags, pricing display, and billing hooks; run internal dogfood with 10 accounts. Phase 2 (8 weeks): Launch randomized experiment. Phase 3 (2 weeks): Analyze results and recommend pricing/packaging. If positive, create rollout tickets for global release and contract template updates.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Entitlement flags implemented and tested in staging. 2) Billing events emitted correctly for add-on acceptance. 3) Legal sign-off on security questionnaire mapping and DPA language for Telemetry-Pro. 4) Instrumentation in analytics dashboard for conversion metrics. 5) Sales playbook and collateral available in Drive.
